messages:
Olivia K: Quick sync — Q1 capacity planning: our running projections (based on current growth + a holiday spike tail) show ~1.15M GPU hours needed across hosted + dedicated. Main ask: decide reservation split between H200 / L40S and fallback plan to H100 for specific latency-sensitive paths. Vendors are quoting 14–18 week lead times for H200.

James R: Can you drop the regional breakdown? need to check quotas and rack space.

Olivia K: Sure — quick table below. This is conservative (10% buffer included).
```
region,model,requested_gpu_hours,q1_weekly_avg
us-west-2,H200,480000,40000
eu-central-1,H200,240000,20000
ap-southeast-1,L40S,300000,25000
fallback,H100,130000,10000
```

Maria S: APAC networking is the blocker — our standard 100Gbps NIC density is already at 85% in ap-southeast-1 racks. If we add L40S nodes we'll need at least two spare 400G uplink switches per pod or we'll hit egress bottlenecks.

Vik P: Lead times match what I'm hearing from distributors. H200 custom SKUs (ECC configs) add 2–3 weeks. L40S stock is much shorter — ~4–6 weeks. If we want H200 in time for Q1, procurement needs PO out within 1–2 weeks.

Liam T: Cost check — rough on-demand equivalent ($/gpu-hour): H200 $3.50, H100 $4.20, L40S $1.60. Reserving vs on-demand break-even depends on utilization; target >=70% util to justify reservations on H200.

Olivia K: Proposal: reserve 70% of H200 need now (spread across us-west-2 + eu-central-1), bulk L40S pooled for APAC inference, and keep a 10% H100 soft-capacity on cloud burst for extreme low-latency routes. This gives cost/leadtimes balance and fallbacks. Thoughts?

James R: +1 for split. Action items: 1) confirm rack + power layout for extra H200 pods in us-west-2 2) open procurement ticket with finance 3) autoscaler policy tweak to prefer L40S for embedding/cheap gen.

procure-bot: New procurement ticket created: `reserve-req-4021` — assigned to @Maria S. Estimated total capex if reservation accepted: $2.9M (one-time + 12mo support).

Maria S: I'll validate rack/power and confirm vendor quotes. If APAC needs extra switches we should budget ~$180k for network uplift.

Vik P: Also flag: bare-metal provider in eu-central-1 reported a maintenance window possibility in week 6 (affects 20% of planned capacity). Recommend we keep a 30% cross-region fallback buffer for that window.

Liam T: From runtime side we'll add a model-routing policy: prefer H200 for high-throughput and H100 for small-batch low-latency cases. Also adding KV-cache warmup across new nodes to avoid cold-start token spikes.

Olivia K: Ok good. Can someone pull together a short procurement + ops runbook (2 pages) that covers: reservation numbers, lead times, rack/power changes, network upgrade, autoscaler config, and rollback plan? Need it by EOD Friday to hit PO window.

James R: I'll draft the ops part (rack/power + autoscaler).

Maria S: I'll draft procurement + vendor appendix and attach quotes.

Vik P: I'll add the maintenance window mitigation and the cross-region fallback config.

Liam T: I'll update routing policies and prepare a small benchmark run on a staging 8xH200 pod to validate throughput targets (target: 60 tokens/sec per core on our gen-3 models).

Olivia K: Perfect. If we all sign off by Friday we can place initial reservations and lock pricing. :thumbsup:

James R: quick note — we should also run a cost-sensitivity for 10/20/30% higher holiday traffic. I'll add that to the ops doc.

Maria S: FYI vendor A offered a conditional 5% early-payment discount if we commit to a 12-month support package. I'll include it in the procurement doc.

Olivia K: Great — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Friday 10am to finalize PO. :calendar:

procure-bot: Reminder scheduled: `reserve-req-4021` review meeting Friday 10:00 (UTC).

Liam T: one last thing — should we also reserve a small test pool of L40S in eu-central-1 to reduce cross-region latency for EU customers? 8–12 nodes.

Olivia K: Yes, add 10-node L40S test pool in eu-central-1 to the ops doc.

James R: noted. Will include rack diagrams and power draw sims.

Maria S: uploading vendor quotes now.

Vik P: tagging @security for H100/H200 firmware signing checks — we need to ensure firmware audit path is clean before deploying into Dedicated.

Olivia K: tagging done. Thanks all.
